text: The Hoare assignment axiom, for command x := E and postcondition P, is:
explanation: The assignment axiom is {P[E/x]} x := E {P}: to make P hold afterward, substitute E for x in P to obtain the precondition (it runs backward). Choice 0 substitutes in the postcondition (wrong direction), choice 1 omits substitution, and choice 3 reverses the substitution.
